units.source_text: 想是源氏的悲恸之心感动了神佛之故：

en.t: Perhaps Genji's grief had moved the gods and Buddhas:

units.source_text: 有一个向未出现过的鬼魂，忽然移附在一个幼年女童身上，

en.t: a spirit that had never appeared before suddenly possessed a young girl,

units.source_text: 她大声叫骂起来，紫夫人便渐渐地苏醒。

en.t: and as the girl began to shout and curse, Lady Murasaki gradually regained consciousness.

units.source_text: 源氏一则以喜，一则以惧，但觉心乱如麻。

en.t: Genji was at once glad and afraid, and his heart felt hopelessly tangled.

units.source_text: 鬼魂被祈祷的法力抑制着，借女童之口叫道：

en.t: The spirit, restrained by the power of the prayers, cried out through the girl's mouth:

units.source_text: “别的人都走开，只留源氏一人听我说话！

en.t: "Everyone else, go away. Leave only Genji here to hear me speak!

units.source_text: 我数月来受法力压制，不胜其苦。

en.t: For months I have been held down by this sacred power, and the suffering is more than I can bear.

units.source_text: 愤恨之极，今天索性显点手段，借此使你知道。

en.t: In the extremity of my resentment, today I decided to show a little of my power and make you know it.

units.source_text: 但我看见你悲伤得不顾身命，颇觉可怜。

en.t: But when I saw you grieving so deeply that you cared nothing for your own life, I felt great pity.

units.source_text: 我身虽已变为可耻之鬼魂，然而并未忘记生前对你的旧情，故而前来探望。

en.t: Though I have become a shameful ghost, I have not forgotten the old affection I bore you in life, and so I came to see you.

units.source_text: 我见你如此痛苦，不能视若无睹，终于向你显灵说话。

en.t: Seeing you suffer like this, I could not look on as if I had seen nothing, and at last I appeared to speak to you.

units.source_text: 我本来是不想教你知道是我的。”

en.t: I had never meant to let you know that it was I."

units.source_text: 那女童哭时额发频频荡动，姿态全同昔年附在葵姬身上的鬼魂一样。

en.t: As the girl wept, the hair over her forehead kept swaying, and her bearing was exactly like that of the spirit that had once possessed Lady Aoi.

units.source_text: 源氏分明记得那时所见可恶可怕之状，此次重见，觉得毫无变更，真乃不祥之兆。

en.t: Genji remembered clearly the hateful and terrifying sight he had seen then; seeing it again now, unchanged in the least, he felt it was truly an ill omen.

units.source_text: 便扯扯女童的手，教她知道不得放肆，对她说道：

en.t: He tugged at the girl's hand to make her understand that she must not be insolent, and said to her:

units.source_text: “我不相信你真是那人的灵魂。

en.t: "I do not believe that you are truly that person's spirit.

units.source_text: 定是恶劣的狐狸冒名顶替，企图宣扬亡人的隐事。

en.t: You must be a wicked fox using her name, trying to spread abroad the hidden affairs of the dead.

units.source_text: 快把你的真姓名说出来！

en.t: Tell me your true name at once!

units.source_text: 还得说些别人所不知而我一人分明记得的旧事。

en.t: And you must speak of old matters unknown to anyone else, which I alone remember clearly.

units.source_text: 如果你说得出，才能使我有几分相信。”

en.t: If you can tell me those things, then I may believe you a little."

units.source_text: 那鬼魂号啕大哭，泪如雨下，带泣带叫地吟道：

en.t: The spirit sobbed aloud, tears falling like rain, and chanted through its weeping cries:
